# Documentation article

An article page of a product's documentation, editorial rather than card-based: a quiet top bar, the navigation,
a reading column limited to a comfortable measure in `ch` with a large title and body, and an "On this page"
table of contents that follows the reading position. The body is Markdown between callouts (Alert) and code
examples in Tabs, whose language choice is shared by every example on the page. The table of contents
highlights the section in view with an IntersectionObserver and scrolls to a heading on click; `Mod+K`
(useHotkeys) opens a CommandPalette over the pages and the sections; a version Select warns about old versions;
a theme toggle uses useTheme; a thin bar under the top bar shows the reading progress with a scroll-driven CSS
animation. The article ends with "Was this page helpful?" (a vote, an optional comment, a thank-you) and links
to the previous and the next page. On narrow widths the table of contents is hidden and the navigation moves
into a Drawer.

**Level**: Scenarios · **Components used**: [Alert](../components/Alert.md), [Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Breadcrumb](../components/Breadcrumb.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [CodeBlock](../components/CodeBlock.md), [CommandPalette](../components/CommandPalette.md), [Drawer](../components/Drawer.md), [Icon](../components/Icon.md), [IconButton](../components/IconButton.md), [Input](../components/Input.md), [Kbd](../components/Kbd.md), [LinkButton](../components/LinkButton.md), [Markdown](../components/Markdown.md), [Nav](../components/Nav.md), [Select](../components/Select.md), [Tabs](../components/Tabs.md), [Text](../components/Text.md), [useHotkeys](../components/useHotkeys.md), [useMessage](../components/useMessage.md)

```tsx
const HEADER_EXAMPLE =
  'Halyard-Signature: t=1763035200,v1=5257a869e7ecebeda32affa62cdca3fa51cad7e77a0e56ff536d0ce8e108d8bd'

const VERIFY: Record<Lang, string> = {
  node: `const crypto = require('node:crypto')

function verify(rawBody, header, secret, toleranceSec = 300) {
  const pairs = header.split(',').map((part) => part.split('='))
  const t = Number(pairs.find(([key]) => key === 't')?.[1])
  const signatures = pairs.filter(([key]) => key === 'v1').map(([, v]) => v)

  if (Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - t) > toleranceSec) return false

  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(\`\${t}.\${rawBody}\`)
    .digest('hex')

  return signatures.some(
    (s) => s.length === expected.length &&
      crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(s), Buffer.from(expected)),
  )
}`,
  python: `import hashlib
import hmac
import time

def verify(raw_body: bytes, header: str, secret: str, tolerance: int = 300) -> bool:
    pairs = [part.split("=", 1) for part in header.split(",")]
    t = int(next(v for k, v in pairs if k == "t"))
    signatures = [v for k, v in pairs if k == "v1"]

    if abs(time.time() - t) > tolerance:
        return False

    payload = f"{t}.".encode() + raw_body
    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return any(hmac.compare_digest(s, expected) for s in signatures)`,
  go: `func Verify(body []byte, header, secret string, tolerance time.Duration) bool {
    var t int64
    var signatures []string
    for _, part := range strings.Split(header, ",") {
        key, value, _ := strings.Cut(part, "=")
        switch key {
        case "t":
            t, _ = strconv.ParseInt(value, 10, 64)
        case "v1":
            signatures = append(signatures, value)
        }
    }
    if time.Since(time.Unix(t, 0)).Abs() > tolerance {
        return false
    }

    mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
    fmt.Fprintf(mac, "%d.%s", t, body)
    expected := hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
    for _, s := range signatures {
        if hmac.Equal([]byte(s), []byte(expected)) {
            return true
        }
    }
    return false
}`,
}

const ROTATE: Record<Lang, string> = {
  node: `const secrets = [process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET, process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET_OLD]
const ok = secrets.filter(Boolean).some((secret) => verify(rawBody, header, secret))`,
  python: `secrets = [os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"], os.environ.get("WEBHOOK_SECRET_OLD")]
ok = any(verify(raw_body, header, s) for s in secrets if s)`,
  go: `ok := Verify(body, header, os.Getenv("WEBHOOK_SECRET"), 5*time.Minute) ||
    Verify(body, header, os.Getenv("WEBHOOK_SECRET_OLD"), 5*time.Minute)`,
}

const PROSE = {
  why: `Every webhook ${PRODUCT} sends carries a **signature** in the \`Halyard-Signature\` header. Checking it proves two things: the request really comes from ${PRODUCT}, and nobody changed the body on the way.

Skip the check, and anyone who learns the address of your endpoint can post events to it: a refund that never happened, or a subscription that was never paid.`,
  signing: `${PRODUCT} signs each delivery with HMAC-SHA256 and the **signing secret** of the endpoint, which you find under *Developers → Webhooks*. The header holds a timestamp \`t\` and one or more signatures \`v1\`:`,
  signingSteps: `The signed payload is the timestamp, a period and the **raw** request body, exactly as it arrived:

1. Read \`t\` and every \`v1\` value from the header.
2. Build the string \`{t}.{raw body}\`.
3. Compute its HMAC-SHA256 with your signing secret, as lowercase hex.
4. Compare the result with each \`v1\` value, in constant time.`,
  verify: `Hash the body before your framework parses it. Parsing the JSON and serializing it again changes whitespace and key order, and the signature no longer matches. The examples take the body as bytes or a string, untouched.`,
  replay: `The timestamp is part of the signed payload, so it cannot be changed without breaking the signature. Reject events whose timestamp is more than **five minutes** away from your clock: a recorded request becomes useless shortly after it was sent.

For a stronger guarantee, store the \`id\` of each processed event and ignore duplicates. Retries reuse the same \`id\`, so this also makes your handler safe to run twice.`,
  retries: `Answer with any \`2xx\` status within **10 seconds** to acknowledge a delivery. Anything else, a timeout included, schedules a retry:

| Attempt | Delay after the previous one | Time since the event |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | immediately | 0 |
| 2 | 1 minute | 1 min |
| 3 | 10 minutes | 11 min |
| 4 | 1 hour | 1 h 11 min |
| 5 | 6 hours | 7 h 11 min |
| 6 | 24 hours | 31 h 11 min |

Each retry is signed again with a fresh timestamp, so a late retry never fails the tolerance check. After the sixth failure the event is marked *failed*; resend it by hand from *Developers → Events*.`,
  rotate: `Roll the secret whenever it may have leaked, and at least once a year. Both secrets stay valid during the switch, so no event is lost:

1. Under *Developers → Webhooks*, choose **Roll secret**. The old one keeps working for 24 hours.
2. Deploy your endpoint with both secrets, accepting a signature made with either of them.
3. Once the deployment is out, remove the old secret, or let it expire.`,
  troubleshooting: `- **Every signature fails.** You are probably hashing a parsed body. In Express, mount \`express.raw({ type: 'application/json' })\` on the webhook route.
- **Signatures fail after a deploy.** The endpoint may read the secret of another environment: test and live endpoints have different secrets.
- **Only some events fail.** A proxy in front of your server may rewrite the body, for example its line endings or its encoding.
- **Events arrive late.** Look at \`delivery_attempt\` in the payload: values above 1 mean earlier attempts failed.`,
}

function useActiveSection(
  scrollerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  idOf: (id: SectionId) => string,
) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<SectionId>(SECTIONS[0].id)
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = scrollerRef.current
    if (!root || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return
    const inBand = new Set<string>()
    let atEnd = false
    const update = () => {
      const first = atEnd
        ? SECTIONS[SECTIONS.length - 1]
        : SECTIONS.find((s) => inBand.has(idOf(s.id)))
      if (first) setActive(first.id)
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const e of entries) {
          if (e.isIntersecting) inBand.add(e.target.id)
          else inBand.delete(e.target.id)
        }
        update()
      },
      // The band: from 15% to 20% of the height of the scrolling area
      { root, rootMargin: '-15% 0px -80% 0px' },
    )
    for (const s of SECTIONS) {
      const el = document.getElementById(idOf(s.id))
      if (el) observer.observe(el)
    }
    const onScroll = () => {
      const end = root.scrollTop + root.clientHeight >= root.scrollHeight - 2
      if (end === atEnd) return
      atEnd = end
      update()
    }
    root.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect()
      root.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
    }
  }, [scrollerRef, idOf])
  return [active, setActive] as const
}

type Vote = 'up' | 'down'

function Feedback() {
  const questionId = useId()
  const [vote, setVote] = useState<Vote | null>(null)
  const [comment, setComment] = useState('')
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false)
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)

  // A real site posts the vote and the comment to its feedback endpoint here
  const send = async () => {
    setSending(true)
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 900))
    setSending(false)
    setSent(true)
  }

  if (sent)
    return (
      <div className={styles.feedback} role="status">
        <span className={styles.thanks}>
          <Icon name="check-circle" size={20} tone="success" />
          <Text weight="semibold">Thank you for the feedback.</Text>
        </span>
        <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
          It goes straight to the people who write these pages.
        </Text>
      </div>
    )

  return (
    <div className={styles.feedback}>
      <div className={styles.voteRow}>
        <Text weight="semibold" id={questionId}>
          Was this page helpful?
        </Text>
        {/* Toggle buttons of our own: aria-pressed tells which one is chosen */}
        <fieldset className={styles.votes} aria-labelledby={questionId}>
          {(['up', 'down'] as const).map((v) => (
            <button
              key={v}
              type="button"
              className={styles.vote}
              data-vl-state=""
              aria-pressed={vote === v}
              onClick={() => setVote(v)}
            >
              <Icon name={v === 'up' ? 'thumbs-up' : 'thumbs-down'} size={16} />
              {v === 'up' ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
      </div>
      {vote && (
        <div className={styles.comment}>
          <Input.TextArea
            aria-label="Comment"
            placeholder={
              vote === 'up'
                ? 'What helped you most? (optional)'
                : 'What was missing or unclear? (optional)'
            }
            autoSize={{ minRows: 2, maxRows: 6 }}
            maxLength={1000}
            value={comment}
            onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)}
          />
          <div className={styles.commentActions}>
            <Button variant="text" disabled={sending} onClick={() => setSent(true)}>
              Skip
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" loading={sending} onClick={send}>
              Send feedback
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export function DocsArticle() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const { mode, setColorMode } = useTheme()
  const nextMode = mode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(LATEST)
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<Lang>('node')
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false)
  const [navOpen, setNavOpen] = useState(false)

  // Element ids unique to this instance, so that two articles on one screen do not share their anchors
  const uid = useId()
  const idOf = useCallback((id: SectionId) => `${uid}-${id}`, [uid])
  const scrollerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [active, setActive] = useActiveSection(scrollerRef, idOf)

  useHotkeys('mod+k', () => setSearchOpen((o) => !o), {
    description: 'Search the documentation',
    allowInInputs: true,
  })

  // Scrolls the article area itself (scrollIntoView would also scroll every container around it). The CSS turns
  // on smooth scrolling unless the user prefers reduced motion
  const scrollTo = (top: number) => scrollerRef.current?.scrollTo({ top })
  const goToSection = (id: SectionId) => {
    const root = scrollerRef.current
    const section = document.getElementById(idOf(id))
    if (!root || !section) return
    setActive(id)
    scrollTo(
      section.getBoundingClientRect().top - root.getBoundingClientRect().top + root.scrollTop,
    )
    // The heading takes the focus, so that keyboard and screen reader users continue from there
    section.querySelector('h2')?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
  }

  // A real site navigates with its router here
  const openPage = (key: string) => {
    setNavOpen(false)
    if (key === CURRENT) return scrollTo(0)
    const page = PAGES.find((p) => p.key === key)
    message.info(`"${page?.label ?? key}" opens here, through the router of the site`)
  }

  const commands: CommandPaletteItem[] = [
    ...SECTIONS.map((s) => ({
      id: `section:${s.id}`,
      title: s.title,
      group: 'On this page',
      icon: 'hash' as const,
      onSelect: () => goToSection(s.id),
    })),
    ...NAV.flatMap((g) =>
      g.items.map((p) => ({
        id: `page:${p.key}`,
        title: p.label,
        group: g.label,
        icon: 'file-text' as const,
        keywords: [g.label],
        onSelect: () => openPage(p.key),
      })),
    ),
    {
      id: 'theme',
      title: `Switch to ${nextMode} mode`,
      group: 'Actions',
      icon: nextMode === 'dark' ? 'moon' : 'sun',
      keywords: ['theme', 'appearance'],
      onSelect: () => setColorMode(nextMode),
    },
  ]

  /** The code tabs: every group shows the language chosen last, in any of them. */
  const codeTabs = (code: Record<Lang, string>, label: string) => (
    <div className={styles.example}>
      <Tabs
        activeKey={lang}
        onChange={(key) => setLang(key as Lang)}
        items={LANGS.map((l) => ({
          key: l.key,
          label: l.label,
          children: (
            <CodeBlock
              code={code[l.key]}
              language={l.code}
              copyable
              maxHeight="lg"
              aria-label={`${label}, ${l.label}`}
            />
          ),
        }))}
      />
    </div>
  )

  const section = (id: SectionId, children: ReactNode) => {
    const index = SECTIONS.findIndex((s) => s.id === id)
    const title = SECTIONS[index]?.title
    return (
      <section id={idOf(id)} className={styles.section} aria-labelledby={`${idOf(id)}-h`}>
        <h2 id={`${idOf(id)}-h`} className={styles.heading} tabIndex={-1}>
          <span className={styles.number} aria-hidden>
            {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
          </span>
          {title}
          <a
            className={styles.anchor}
            href={`#${idOf(id)}`}
            aria-label={`Link to ${title}`}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault()
              goToSection(id)
            }}
          >
            <Icon name="link" size={16} />
          </a>
        </h2>
        {children}
      </section>
    )
  }

  const nav = <Nav aria-label="Documentation" items={NAV} value={CURRENT} onSelect={openPage} />

  return (
    <div className={styles.docs}>
      <header className={styles.topbar}>
        <span className={styles.menuButton}>
          <IconButton icon="sidebar" label="Open navigation" onClick={() => setNavOpen(true)} />
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.brand}
          data-vl-state=""
          onClick={() => openPage('introduction')}
        >
          <span className={styles.mark}>
            <Icon name="webhook" size={16} />
          </span>
          {PRODUCT}
          <span className={styles.brandDocs}>Docs</span>
        </button>
        <Select
          aria-label="Documentation version"
          size="sm"
          variant="borderless"
          value={version}
          onChange={setVersion}
          options={VERSIONS}
        />
        <span className={styles.spacer} />
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.search}
          data-vl-state=""
          onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
        >
          <Icon name="search" size={16} />
          <span className={styles.searchLabel}>Search the docs</span>
          <Kbd keys="mod+k" />
        </button>
        <IconButton
          icon={nextMode === 'dark' ? 'moon' : 'sun'}
          label={`Switch to ${nextMode} mode`}
          onClick={() => setColorMode(nextMode)}
        />
        {/* Reading progress: a scroll-driven animation in the CSS, no script */}
        <span className={styles.progress} aria-hidden />
      </header>

      <div className={styles.body} ref={scrollerRef}>
        <div className={styles.layout}>
          <aside className={styles.sidebar}>{nav}</aside>

          <main className={styles.article}>
            <header className={styles.articleHeader}>
              <Breadcrumb
                items={[
                  { title: 'Docs', onClick: () => openPage('introduction') },
                  { title: 'Webhooks', onClick: () => openPage('webhooks') },
                  { title: 'Verify signatures' },
                ]}
              />
              <h1 className={styles.title}>Verify webhook signatures</h1>
              <p className={styles.lede}>
                Make sure that every event your endpoint receives was sent by {PRODUCT} and arrived
                unchanged, and turn away old events that someone recorded and plays back.
              </p>
              <div className={styles.meta}>
                <span className={styles.authors}>
                  {AUTHORS.map((name) => (
                    <span key={name} className={styles.author}>
                      <Avatar name={name} size={24} />
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </span>
                <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
                  {AUTHORS[0]} and {AUTHORS.length - 1} others
                </Text>
                <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden />
                <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" as="time" dateTime="2026-11-04">
                  Updated Nov 4, 2026
                </Text>
                <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden />
                <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
                  7 min read
                </Text>
              </div>
            </header>

            {version !== LATEST && (
              <Alert
                tone="warning"
                showIcon
                title={`You are reading the documentation of v${version}`}
                description={
                  <>
                    Signatures work the same way, but the SDK calls differ.{' '}
                    <LinkButton onClick={() => setVersion(LATEST)}>Switch to v{LATEST}</LinkButton>
                  </>
                }
              />
            )}

            {section(
              'why',
              <>
                <div className={styles.prose}>
                  <Markdown content={PROSE.why} />
                </div>
                <Alert
                  showIcon
                  title="The SDKs verify for you"
                  description="From version 4.2, the official libraries do all of this in one call, webhooks.constructEvent(). Read on to see what it checks, or if you use another language."
                />
              </>,
            )}
            {section(
              'signing',
              <>
                <div className={styles.prose}>
                  <Markdown content={PROSE.signing} />
                </div>
                <CodeBlock
                  code={HEADER_EXAMPLE}
                  language="http"
                  wrap
                  aria-label="Signature header"
                />
                <div className={styles.prose}>
                  <Markdown content={PROSE.signingSteps} />
                </div>
              </>,
            )}
            {section(
              'verify',
              <>
                <div className={styles.prose}>
                  <Markdown content={PROSE.verify} />
                </div>
                {codeTabs(VERIFY, 'Verify a signature')}
              </>,
            )}
            {section(
              'replay',
              <>
                <div className={styles.prose}>
                  <Markdown content={PROSE.replay} />
                </div>
                <Alert
                  tone="warning"
                  showIcon
                  title="Keep your server clock in sync"
                  description="A clock that drifts by more than the tolerance rejects every event. Run NTP on your servers, or widen the tolerance while you investigate."
                />
              </>,
            )}
            {section(
              'retries',
              <div className={styles.prose}>
                <Markdown content={PROSE.retries} />
              </div>,
            )}
            {section(
              'rotate',
              <>
                <div className={styles.prose}>
                  <Markdown content={PROSE.rotate} />
                </div>
                {codeTabs(ROTATE, 'Accept two secrets')}
              </>,
            )}
            {section(
              'troubleshooting',
              <div className={styles.prose}>
                <Markdown content={PROSE.troubleshooting} />
              </div>,
            )}

            <footer className={styles.articleFooter}>
              <Feedback />
              <nav className={styles.pager} aria-label="Previous and next page">
                {[PREV, NEXT].map(
                  (page, i) =>
                    page && (
                      <button
                        key={page.key}
                        type="button"
                        className={styles.pagerLink}
                        data-vl-state=""
                        data-direction={i === 0 ? 'prev' : 'next'}
                        onClick={() => openPage(page.key)}
                      >
                        <span className={styles.pagerHint}>
                          {i === 0 && <Icon name="arrow-left" size={14} />}
                          {i === 0 ? 'Previous' : 'Next'}
                          {i === 1 && <Icon name="arrow-right" size={14} />}
                        </span>
                        <span className={styles.pagerTitle}>{page.label}</span>
                      </button>
                    ),
                )}
              </nav>
            </footer>
          </main>

          <aside className={styles.toc} aria-labelledby={`${uid}-toc`}>
            <Text overline id={`${uid}-toc`}>
              On this page
            </Text>
            <ol className={styles.tocList}>
              {SECTIONS.map((s) => (
                <li key={s.id}>
                  <a
                    className={styles.tocLink}
                    href={`#${idOf(s.id)}`}
                    aria-current={active === s.id ? 'location' : undefined}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault()
                      goToSection(s.id)
                    }}
                  >
                    {s.title}
                  </a>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
            <div className={styles.tocActions}>
              <LinkButton icon="arrow-up" onClick={() => scrollTo(0)}>
                Back to top
              </LinkButton>
              <LinkButton
                icon="edit"
                onClick={() => message.info('The editor of the page opens here')}
              >
                Edit this page
              </LinkButton>
            </div>
          </aside>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Drawer
        open={navOpen}
        onClose={() => setNavOpen(false)}
        title={`${PRODUCT} Docs`}
        width={320}
      >
        {nav}
      </Drawer>
      <CommandPalette
        open={searchOpen}
        onOpenChange={setSearchOpen}
        items={commands}
        placeholder="Search pages and sections"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

`DocsArticle.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Documentation article: an editorial page rather than a page of cards. The look comes from type and whitespace:
 * one bright reading surface, a column limited to a comfortable measure in ch, a large title and body, hairlines
 * instead of panels, and chrome (top bar, navigation, table of contents) kept quiet in the secondary text color.
 *
 * Every value is a token (var(--vl-...)), a relative unit or 0 / 1px, so the page follows the color mode, the
 * accent color and the density. Hover, press and focus of our own buttons come from the shared state layer
 * (data-vl-state); ::before is left to the library.
 */

/*
 * The frame: a surface that fills its container, a top bar and a scrolling area below it. It is a size-aware
 * container (docs), so the columns respond to the width of the page itself, not of the window. timeline-scope
 * lets the progress bar in the top bar follow the scrolling of its sibling, the body.
 */
.docs {
  container: docs / inline-size;
  timeline-scope: --docs-scroll;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-xl);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
  /* Dark mode has no card shadow: the hairline keeps the edge */
  box-shadow:
    var(--vl-shadow-near),
    0 0 0 1px var(--vl-color-border);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-md);

  --docs-nav-width: calc(var(--vl-grid-column-md) - var(--vl-space-5));
  --docs-toc-width: calc(var(--vl-grid-column-sm) + var(--vl-space-6));
}

/* —— Top bar: slim, a hairline below, nothing louder than the brand —— */

.topbar {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-4);
  border-bottom: var(--vl-border-width) solid var(--vl-color-border);
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) var(--vl-space-2);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-md);
  background: none;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* The product mark: the accent, solid, with its own text color */
.mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: calc(var(--vl-space-5) + var(--vl-space-1));
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-sm);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--vl-color-accent-fill),
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-accent-fill) 70%, var(--vl-color-chart-7))
  );
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
}

.brandDocs {
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-regular);
}

.spacer {
  flex: 1;
}

/* The search field look-alike: a quiet well that opens the command palette */
.search {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  width: min(100%, calc(var(--vl-grid-column-md) + var(--vl-space-5)));
  height: var(--vl-control-height-sm);
  padding-inline: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-1);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-fill-field);
  box-shadow: var(--vl-shadow-field);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.searchLabel {
  flex: 1;
  text-align: start;
}

/*
 * Reading progress: a hairline of the accent over the border of the top bar, scaled by the scroll position of the
 * body through a scroll-driven animation. Browsers without scroll timelines keep it at zero width.
 */
.progress {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  bottom: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * -1);
  height: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 2);
  background: var(--vl-color-accent);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
  .progress {
    animation: docs-progress linear both;
    animation-timeline: --docs-scroll;
  }
}

@keyframes docs-progress {
  to {
    transform: scaleX(1);
  }
}

/* The menu button that opens the navigation drawer: only on narrow pages */
.menuButton {
  display: none;
}

/* —— The scrolling area and its three columns —— */

/*
 * The body scrolls; it is a size container too, so the side columns can be as tall as its visible height
 * (100cqb) while they stick to its top. Smooth scrolling only for people who have not asked for reduced motion.
 */
.body {
  container: docs-body / size;
  scroll-timeline: --docs-scroll block;
  overflow: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .body {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
}

.layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--docs-nav-width) minmax(0, 1fr) var(--docs-toc-width);
  gap: var(--vl-space-7);
  max-width: calc(var(--vl-page-width-default) + var(--vl-space-8) * 2);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: var(--vl-space-4) var(--vl-space-6);
}

.sidebar,
.toc {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  align-self: start;
  max-height: 100cqb;
  overflow: auto;
  padding-block: var(--vl-space-5);
}

/* —— The article: the reading column —— */

/*
 * The measure: about 66 characters of the body size per line, set in ch of that size. The body size is one step
 * above the interface (lg rather than md), for long reading.
 */
.article {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-5);
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 66ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-block: var(--vl-space-7) var(--vl-space-8);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-body);
}

.articleHeader {
  /* The breadcrumb keeps the interface size; the title and the lede set their own */
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-md);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
  padding-bottom: var(--vl-space-5);
  border-bottom: var(--vl-border-width) solid var(--vl-color-border);
}

/* A title larger than Heading offers, made of the heading tokens */
.title {
  margin: var(--vl-space-2) 0 0;
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-heading);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
  letter-spacing: var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.lede {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-body);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

/* Overlapping avatars, each with a ring of the surface so the edges stay apart */
.authors {
  display: inline-flex;
  margin-inline-end: var(--vl-space-1);
}

.author {
  display: inline-flex;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 2) var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
}

.author + .author {
  margin-inline-start: calc(var(--vl-space-2) * -1);
}

.dot {
  width: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 3);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
}

/*
 * Sections. The top padding (not a margin) leaves no gap between them, so one of them is always under the band
 * the table of contents watches.
 */
.section {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
  padding-top: var(--vl-space-6);
}

.heading {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-heading);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
  letter-spacing: var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading);
  outline: none;
}

/* The section number: small, monospace, in the accent, like the folio of a printed page */
.number {
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* The link to the section shows on hover of the heading and on keyboard focus */
.anchor {
  align-self: center;
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: var(--vl-space-1);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-sm);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--vl-motion-duration-fast) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard);
}

.heading:hover .anchor,
.anchor:focus-visible {
  opacity: 1;
}

.anchor:focus-visible {
  outline: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 2) solid var(--vl-color-focus-ring);
}

/*
 * Markdown sets its text in --vl-font-size-md. Inside the article that step is redefined as the body size of the
 * article, so the prose reads at lg like the rest of the column; nothing outside .prose is affected.
 */
.prose {
  --vl-font-size-md: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
}

/* Code examples get a little more air than the prose around them */
.example {
  margin-block: var(--vl-space-1);
}

/* —— End of the article: feedback and the previous and next pages —— */

.articleFooter {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-6);
  margin-top: var(--vl-space-6);
  padding-top: var(--vl-space-6);
  border-top: var(--vl-border-width) solid var(--vl-color-border);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-md);
}

.feedback {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}

.voteRow {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}

.votes {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  min-inline-size: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

/* Vote buttons: pills that fill with the accent wash once chosen */
.vote {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-sm);
  padding-inline: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-4);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-fill-control);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.vote[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--vl-color-accent-subtle);
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
}

.comment {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
  /* biome-ignore lint/correctness/noUnknownFunction: global() references keyframes outside the CSS Module */
  animation: global(vl-rise) var(--vl-motion-duration-slow) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard) both;
}

.commentActions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.thanks {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

/*
 * Previous and next: two link cards side by side, the next one aligned to the end. Borderless: a faint well of
 * the field fill marks them on the reading surface, in both modes.
 */
.pager {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
}

.pagerLink {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-4) var(--vl-space-5);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-xl);
  background: var(--vl-color-fill-field);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.pagerLink[data-direction="next"] {
  grid-column: 2;
  align-items: flex-end;
  text-align: end;
}

.pagerHint {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
}

.pagerTitle {
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* —— On this page: a rail with the section in view marked in the accent —— */

.toc {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
  padding-top: var(--vl-space-7);
}

.tocList {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  border-inline-start: var(--vl-border-width) solid var(--vl-color-border-strong);
}

.tocLink {
  display: block;
  margin-inline-start: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * -1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) var(--vl-space-3);
  border-inline-start: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 2) solid transparent;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition:
    color var(--vl-motion-duration-fast) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard),
    border-color var(--vl-motion-duration-fast) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard);
}

.tocLink:hover {
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
}

.tocLink:focus-visible {
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-sm);
  outline: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 2) solid var(--vl-color-focus-ring);
}

.tocLink[aria-current="location"] {
  border-inline-start-color: var(--vl-color-accent);
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
}

.tocActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  padding-top: var(--vl-space-3);
  border-top: var(--vl-border-width) solid var(--vl-color-border);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-sm);
}

/* —— Narrower pages —— */

/* No room for three columns: the table of contents goes (the command palette still lists the sections) */
@container docs (width < 80em) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: var(--docs-nav-width) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: var(--vl-space-6);
  }

  .toc {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* One column: the navigation moves into a drawer, opened from the top bar */
@container docs (width < 58em) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    padding-inline: var(--vl-space-5);
  }

  .sidebar {
    display: none;
  }

  .menuButton {
    display: contents;
  }

  .article {
    padding-top: var(--vl-space-5);
  }

  .title {
    font-size: var(--vl-font-size-3xl);
  }
}

/* A phone: the search shrinks to its icon and shortcut, the previous and next pages stack */
@container docs (width < 36em) {
  .searchLabel {
    display: none;
  }

  .search {
    width: auto;
  }

  .pager {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .pagerLink[data-direction="next"] {
    grid-column: 1;
  }
}
```
